headline: Approved CPRB Training Procedures and found due process standards met in IA Cases 2025-014 and 2026-001.
summary: The board elected Joey Brunelle as Chair and Rachel Schlein as Vice Chair, approved its Training Procedures as amended for submission to the City Council, and after an executive session found that the investigations of IA Case 2025-014 and IA Case 2026-001 were thorough, timely, fair, and objective. The board also discussed an IA Case Review spreadsheet, upcoming trainings, and future case review assignments.
decisions: Nominated Diane Herrmann as Vice Vice Chair, approved 4-0 with Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent.
Nominated Rachel Schlein as Vice Chair, approved 4-0 with Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent.
Nominated Joey Brunelle as Chair, approved 4-0 with Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent.
Approved the September 9, 2026 CPRB Meeting Minutes, 4-0 with Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent.
Approved the CPRB Training Procedures as amended and sent them to the City Council for approval, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was thorough, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was timely, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was objective, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was fair, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was thorough, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was timely, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was fair, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.
Found the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was objective, 5-0 with Finley and Schmitz absent.

decision_evidence.quote: TJ Boisclair nominated Diane Herrmann as Vice Vice Chair. The nomination passed unanimously (4/0, Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent).
Diane Herrmann nominated Rachel Schlein as Vice Chair. The nomination passed unanimously (4/0, Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent).
TJ Boisclair nominated Joey Brunelle as Chair. The nomination passed unanimously (4/0, Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Boisclair made a motion to approve the September 9, 2026 CPRB Meeting Minutes. Seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (4/0, Finley, Liberatore, and Schmitz absent).

Mr. Boisclair made a motion to approve the CPRB Training Procedures (as amended) and submit the same to the City Council for approval. Seconded by Mr. Sims. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Boisclair made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was thorough. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Boisclair made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was timely. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Boisclair made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was objective. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Boisclair made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2025-014 was fair. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Biha made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was thorough. The motion was seconded by Mr. Boisclair. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Biha made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was timely. The motion was seconded by Mr. Boisclair. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Biha made a motion to find that the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was fair. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
Mr. Biha made a find to declare that the investigation of IA Case 2026-001 was objective. The motion was seconded by Ms. Herrmann. The motion passed unanimously (5/0, Finley and Schmitz absent).
